## 📦 COMPLETE PRODUCT CATALOG (8 MAIN PRODUCTS)

### 1. FRP Molded Grating (Most Popular)
**Definition:** FRP molded grating is a one-piece composite grid structure manufactured by casting continuous glass fiber strands and thermosetting resin in precision-heated metal molds, providing bidirectional equal strength.

**Available Specifications:**
- Thickness: 25mm (light duty), 30mm (medium), 38mm (standard), 50mm (heavy duty)
- Mesh opening: 19×19mm (mini mesh), 38×38mm (standard), 40×40mm, 50×50mm
- Standard panel size: 1220mm × 3660mm (4'×12'), 1000mm × 4000mm, custom sizes
- Resin systems: Orthophthalic Polyester, Isophthalic Polyester, Vinyl Ester, Phenolic
- Surface options: Concave/Meniscus top, Grit top (R13 anti-slip), Smooth, Covered solid
- Colors: Yellow, gray, green, blue, red, custom colors

**Typical Load Capacity (38mm, 38×38mm mesh):**
- At 600mm span: 5.0 kN/m² uniform load, deflection < 5mm
- At 1000mm span: 3.5 kN/m² uniform load
- Safety factor: 3.0:1
- Weight: 15-20 kg/m²
- Glass content: 60-65% by weight

**Standards Compliance:** ASTM E-84 (Class A flame spread), EN 13706, FGMC

**Applications:** Walkways, platforms, stair treads, trench covers, drainage covers, solar rooftop walkways, wastewater treatment, chemical plants, offshore platforms

---

### 2. FRP Pultruded Grating (Heavy Duty)
**Definition:** FRP pultruded grating is manufactured by pulling continuous glass fiber rovings through a resin impregnation bath and precision-heated steel die, producing bars with highly aligned unidirectional fibers (70-75% fiber content) for exceptional longitudinal strength and large span capability.

**Available Specifications:**
- Bar profiles: I-beam (standard), T-bar, rectangular tube
- Bar height: 25mm, 38mm, 50mm, 65mm, 75mm, 100mm
- Bearing bar spacing: 30mm, 38mm, 50mm on center
- Cross bars: 6mm diameter solid rods or 25×3mm flat bars, spaced 100-150mm
- Resin: Isophthalic, Vinyl Ester, Phenolic (fire retardant)
- Surface: Grit top (integral quartz), smooth

**Typical Load Capacity (50mm I-bar):**
- At 1000mm span: 25 kN/m² uniform load
- Point load: 5 kN at center, deflection < L/240
- Bending strength: 350-420 MPa
- Elastic modulus: 20-25 GPa (longitudinal)
- Design code: ASTM D3916, EUROCOMP

**Applications:** Heavy industrial platforms, forklift traffic areas, bridge decking, offshore oil & gas, mining conveyor platforms, high-load walkways

---

### 3. FRP Solid Covers & Panels
**Definition:** FRP solid covers provide full coverage with no openings, used for trench covers, drain covers, and platforms where items cannot fall through.

**Specifications:**
- Thickness: 25mm, 30mm, 38mm, 50mm
- Panel size: 1220×3660mm, custom
- Surface: Grit top, smooth, concave
- Resin: Polyester, Isophthalic, Vinyl Ester
- Load capacity: Same as molded grating of same thickness
- Waterproof: Yes, no openings

**Applications:** Trench covers, chemical spill containment, drain covers, food processing floors, pharmaceutical clean rooms

---

### 4. FRP Pultruded Profiles & Structural Shapes
**Definition:** FRP pultruded profiles are constant cross-section composite shapes used as structural replacement for steel in corrosive environments.

**Available Profiles:**
- I-beam: 50×28mm to 200×100mm
- Channel (C-channel): 40×20mm to 150×50mm
- Equal angle: 25×25mm to 100×100mm
- Square tube: 25×25mm to 150×150mm
- Round tube: 25mm to 150mm diameter
- Flat bar: 3×25mm to 12×100mm
- Rod: 6mm to 50mm diameter

**Mechanical Properties:**
- Longitudinal tensile: 300-400 MPa
- Compressive: 200-280 MPa
- Shear: 40-60 MPa
- Elastic modulus: 15-25 GPa
- Design code: EUROCOMP, ASCE

**Applications:** Structural support beams, platform supports, handrail posts, ladder rails, cable trays, cooling tower components

---

### 5. FRP Handrail & Stair Systems
**Definition:** Complete FRP handrail, ladder, and stair systems designed for corrosive environments where steel rusts rapidly.

**Components:**
- Handrail: Round tube (48mm OD) or square tube (50×50mm)
- Posts: 50×50mm square tube or 48mm round tube
- Rails: 32mm or 38mm round tube
- Ladders: With or without safety cages, 300-600mm width
- Stair treads: 38mm or 50mm thick molded grating
- Fittings: Elbows, tees, crosses, base plates (all FRP or SS316)

**Compliance:** OSHA 1910.23, EN ISO 14122, BS 4592

**Applications:** Industrial platforms, wastewater plants, chemical facilities, offshore platforms, rooftops

---

**Services:**
- CNC cutting to exact sizes

- Notching for pipes and columns

### 7. FRP Grating Clips & Fasteners
**Types:**

- C-Clip (side mount)
- L-Clip (edge mount)
- Z-Clip (special applications)
- Base plates (for handrail posts)

**Materials:**

**Specifications:** M8 or M10 bolts, recommended 4 clips per standard panel

## 🧪 RESIN SYSTEM SELECTION GUIDE

| Resin Type | Corrosion Resistance | Temperature | Fire Rating | Cost | Best For |
|------------|---------------------|-------------|-------------|------|----------|
| Orthophthalic Polyester | Fair (dilute acids, water) | -40 to 60°C | Standard | Low | Indoor, dry, mild environments |
| Isophthalic Polyester | Good (acids up to 30%, alkalis up to 20%) | -40 to 80°C | Standard | Medium | Wastewater, outdoor, marine |
| Vinyl Ester | Excellent (50% H2SO4, 50% NaOH, solvents) | -40 to 120°C | Self-extinguishing | High | Chemical plants, offshore, severe corrosion |
| Phenolic | Good (acids, solvents) | -40 to 180°C | V-0 (UL 94), low smoke | Highest | Mining, tunnels, offshore living quarters, fire-critical |

---

## 📊 CHEMICAL RESISTANCE REFERENCE

| Chemical | Concentration | Polyester | Isophthalic | Vinyl Ester | Phenolic |
|----------|--------------|-----------|-------------|-------------|----------|
| Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4) | 10% | Fair | Good | Excellent | Good |
| Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4) | 50% | Poor | Fair | Excellent | Good |
| Hydrochloric Acid (HCl) | 37% | Poor | Fair | Excellent | Good |
| Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) | 20% | Poor | Good | Excellent | Fair |
| Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) | 50% | Poor | Poor | Excellent | Fair |
| Sodium Hypochlorite (Bleach) | 15% | Poor | Fair | Excellent | Good |
| Seawater / Salt Spray | - | Fair | Good | Excellent | Good |
| Gasoline / Diesel | - | Poor | Fair | Good | Good |
| Ammonia | - | Fair | Good | Excellent | Good |

## 🌍 GLOBAL PROJECT CASE STUDIES

### Case 1: Wastewater Treatment Plant - Germany
- Product: 38mm Molded FRP Grating, Vinyl Ester
- Quantity: 1,850 m²
- Surface: Grit top
- Color: Yellow
- Challenge: H2S corrosion, constant moisture
- Solution: Vinyl ester resin, 20+ year lifespan
- Result: Installed 2019, zero maintenance to date

### Case 2: Offshore Platform - Norway
- Product: Pultruded FRP Grating, 50mm I-bar
- Quantity: 320 m²
- Material: Vinyl Ester, fire retardant
- Fasteners: SS316 clips
- Challenge: Saltwater, high wind, fire regulations
- Solution: Fire-retardant vinyl ester, SS316 hardware
- Result: Delivered in 18 days, approved by DNV

### Case 3: Chemical Plant - Netherlands
- Product: Heavy-duty Pultruded Grating, 65mm
- Quantity: 750 m²
- Material: Isophthalic/Vinyl Ester hybrid
- Challenge: Strong acid exposure, forklift traffic
- Solution: 65mm deep I-bar, grit surface
- Result: Replaced steel grating that failed in 3 years

### Case 4: Solar Farm Walkway - Australia
- Product: 38mm Molded Grating, Mini Mesh (19×19)
- Quantity: 2,400 m²
- Material: Isophthalic Polyester
- Challenge: Non-conductive required, UV exposure
- Solution: UV-stabilized isophthalic, mini mesh for tool safety
- Result: 30% faster installation than steel

### Case 5: Desalination Plant - UAE
- Product: 38mm Molded + Handrail System
- Quantity: 1,200 m² grating + 800m handrail
- Material: Vinyl Ester
- Challenge: High salinity, 50°C temperatures
- Solution: Vinyl ester resin, UV-stabilized
- Result: Operating since 2021, no corrosion
